AC-31
AIR CONDITIONING BLOWER UNIT
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE GLOVE COMPARTMENT PARTS
(See page B0-79)
2. REMOVE BLOWER UNIT
(a) Disconnect the connector and air inlet control cable. \ {b) Remove wire harness clamp.
(c) Remove the 2 screws, 2 nuts and the blower unit.
